## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 384 photographic captures during March 2021. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine service delivery. The recorded total provides the basis for review of image quality and grading performance for the month.

## Image quality

There were 8 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.1 per cent. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and identify any recurring operational issues that may affect the suitability of captures for grading. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

A total of 75 results were graded as referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This measure should be considered alongside the monthly activity and image-quality results when reviewing service performance. The clinic lead should continue to raise any persistent equipment or workflow concerns through the service desk, supporting timely investigation and maintaining consistent image capture and grading arrangements.
